canonical_statement: The NOBILITY trial tested whether enhanced B-cell depletion with obinutuzumab added to standard care would increase complete renal response compared with standard care alone in proliferative lupus nephritis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The NOBILITY trial was conducted to test the hypothesis that enhanced B-cell depletion with obinutuzumab would increase the rate of CRR.

canonical_statement: NOBILITY was a multicentre, double-blind, phase 2, randomised, placebo-controlled trial conducted at 43 sites in North America, South America, Europe and Israel.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This multicentre, double-blind, phase 2, randomised, controlled trial was performed at 43 sites in North America, South America, Europe and Israel.

canonical_statement: Eligible adults were 18-75 years old with SLE, biopsy-proven class III or IV active or active/chronic lupus nephritis within 6 months, UPCR >1, and eGFR >=30 mL/min/1.73 m2; concomitant class V was permitted.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Eligible adults were aged 18–75 years, had SLE ... class III or IV ... UPCR >1 ... and eGFR of ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m2.

population.label: Adults with biopsy-proven proliferative lupus nephritis
inclusion_criteria: ISN/RPS class III or IV active or active/chronic LN within 6 months

canonical_statement: The intervention was obinutuzumab 1000 mg IV on day 1 and weeks 2, 24 and 26, with all patients receiving mycophenolate mofetil and protocol-mandated corticosteroids.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Obinutuzumab was administered as a blinded intravenous infusion of 1000 mg on day 1 and weeks 2, 24 and 26.

exposures.details: Added to background mycophenolate mofetil and protocol-mandated corticosteroids.

canonical_statement: The control arm received matching intravenous placebo on day 1 and weeks 2, 24 and 26, with the same background mycophenolate mofetil and corticosteroid regimen.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients randomly assigned to placebo received an intravenous placebo infusion on day 1 and weeks 2, 24 and 26.

exposures.details: Added to background mycophenolate mofetil and protocol-mandated corticosteroids.

canonical_statement: All patients targeted mycophenolate mofetil 2-2.5 g/day and received protocol-mandated corticosteroids, including IV methylprednisolone 1000-3000 mg total and prednisone tapered to 7.5 mg/day by week 12.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: All patients received mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) (target dose 2–2.5 g/day ... prednisone ... taper to 7.5 mg/day by week 12).

canonical_statement: Complete renal response required UPCR <0.5, serum creatinine <=ULN without >15% worsening from baseline, and inactive urinary sediment (<10 RBCs/HPF without RBC casts).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The primary endpoint at week 52 was ... CRR ... requiring UPCR <0.5 ... serum creatinine ≤ULN ... and inactive urinary sediment.

outcome.definition: UPCR <0.5; serum creatinine <=ULN without >15% worsening from baseline; <10 RBCs/HPF without RBC casts

canonical_statement: Partial renal response required at least 50% UPCR reduction to <1 (or <3 if baseline UPCR >=3), serum creatinine not increased >15%, and improvement in urinary RBCs.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: PRR ... requiring ≥50% reduction in UPCR from baseline ... serum creatinine not increased >15% ... and urinary RBCs <10/HPF or ≤50% increase.

canonical_statement: Overall renal response was achieved if either complete renal response or partial renal response was achieved.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: overall renal response (ORR), which was met if CRR or PRR was achieved

canonical_statement: Modified complete renal response required UPCR <0.5 g/g and serum creatinine <=ULN.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: modified CRR (mCRR), a composite measure requiring UPCR <0.5 g/g and serum creatinine ≤ULN

canonical_statement: The proof-of-concept trial used a two-sided alpha of 0.20, projected 60 patients per group for 83% power, and used a fixed-sequence procedure for primary and secondary endpoint testing; exploratory analyses were not multiplicity controlled.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 60 patients in each group were projected to yield 83% power ... at a two-sided alpha of 0.2 ... Type I error rate was not controlled for exploratory analyses.

canonical_statement: Efficacy used a modified intention-to-treat population of all randomised patients receiving at least one study dose; safety was analysed according to treatment received.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Efficacy analyses were done in a modified intention-to-treat population ... Safety analyses were grouped according to the treatment received.

canonical_statement: Of 242 patients screened, 125 were randomised and treated (63 obinutuzumab, 62 placebo); 115 (92%) completed 52 weeks and 103 (82%) completed 104 weeks.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Two hundred and forty-two patients were screened, of whom 125 were randomised ... 115 patients (92%) completed 52 weeks, and 103 patients (82%) completed 104 weeks.

canonical_statement: The cohort was 85% women with mean age 33 years; 73% self-identified as Hispanic or Latino, 74% had class IV lupus nephritis, and 30% had concomitant class V disease.
